title: Braised Kippers with Vietnamese Flair
description: A fusion dish combining traditional braising with the bold flavors of Vietnam. Pair kippers with a rich umami sauce and dense vegetables for a hearty meal.

ingredients.name: Kippers
ingredients.notes: Fresh or canned, drained and rinsed

ingredients.name: Umami Sauce
ingredients.notes: Store-bought or homemade, mix of soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar

instructions: 2. Season the kippers with salt and pepper.
3. Heat the vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
4. Sear the kippers for 2-3 minutes per side, then set aside.
5. Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until caramelized.
6. Add the minced garlic and sliced ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
7. Add the umami sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, and brown sugar to the pot.
8. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
9. Return the kippers to the pot and cover with a lid.
10. Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 10-12 minutes.
11. Serve the kippers over cooked rice with the braising liquid spooned over the top.
